item: G2-01 (Q2-9 history grid, Q2-6 search reveal, G2-25 history width, Q1-2 carrier)
frame: W13 probe frame on the W10 campaign runtime (S9 framerail :3410, fixture acceptance/history surfaces)

history_grid.finding: Without: document 472px at a 390px viewport (the same overflow the G2-25 real-content A/B measured, candidate 404 vs native 390 on frozen scp-173 history). With the 1fr correction the document fits 390 and the option row takes the two-row form of the JP target at both widths.

search_reveal.finding: The candidate collapses the search form to a 27px icon box with #search-top-box-input at display:none; the historical reveal adaptation was classified REMOVE in the authority cleanup, so nothing reveals the input on hover/focus (baseline hover run g201e confirms it stays none). With the block, hovering or focusing within the form reveals a 128px typeable input at both widths. Without a width the input stays 27px at desktop (g201f), hence width:8rem.

nav_labels: Q1-2 carrier: the correction applies the JP keep-all label treatment to the top bars; verification is the W13 scoped recapture of the nav states (the fixture nav composition is provisioned by the capture machinery). W11 frame evidence: BHL-family mobile bar fragments the data label mid-word (W12-REVIEW-A Q1-2).
